chapter: Cincinnati riverboats and New Orleans players
title: Hearing Fate Marable's band and Pops Foster in Cincinnati
summary: On the Island Queen to Coney Island, Davison heard Fate Marable's riverboat band with Pops Foster and Marable's calliope.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: Our, uh, tape open, you were telling me about having seen Pops Foster

Oh, well you see the, uh, Faith Marable band Is that the way you say it? Faith Marable band Used to, uh, pull in Cincinnati And at that time We were on the Island Queen The, uh, uh, Chubb Steinberg band was on the Island Queen And the idea was Each night we would, uh, sort of late afternoon We'd play up to Coney Island There's an amusement park there in Cincinnati called Coney Island And we'd play on the Island Queen Until we got to the island And then we'd play all evening And then play back And so Pops Foster was on something, something bell showboat I can't remember whether it was the Capitol I think once they were on the Capitol And the old Capitol is Some fella just bought it recently in St. Louis Still doing And, uh, I used to hear that band, you know And it was just too much I couldn't believe it It was so good
Do you remember anybody that had said Pops?
No, I don't I remember, I remember that, uh, Faith used to, uh, Faith used to play, uh, the Calliope When the boat was docking, you know, hot Calliope Which was, uh,
Uh, but you ran into Pops frequently then?
Yeah, and Pops looks exactly today as he looked then He never ages one day
